integrity: The M1 and M2 maxima are certified by an exact exhaustive polyhedral reduction over all tight-facet triples in Q(sqrt(3)); the M3 value follows analytically from concavity and the M1 bound. The explicit equality pair is checked exactly. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the regular dodecagonal Banach plane. It does not classify the midline constants on all regular polygons or all non-Hilbert spaces sharing Hilbert-space values, and it does not classify every maximizing pair.
title: Hilbert-value midline constants of the regular dodecagonal Banach plane
